briefdescription.para: Lazy-locking cast utility for wrapper and plain value references.

detaileddescription.para: scl::wrapper_cast() returns a wrapper_caster<Refer> proxy that captures references to every executor in the wrapper chain without acquiring any guard. Guards are activated lazily, only at the moment the proxy is converted to the desired target type.
This allows generic code to cast uniformly through wrapper chains: non-wrapper types are passed through as-is via a no-op overload.
